content:
A fire destroyed two homes in Nuevo Laredo's Colonia Matamoros on Wednesday night, November 5, leaving an elderly man and his son with nothing, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The fire broke out on Calle Artículo 25, between Mártires de Chicago and Artículo 123. The two homes, built of wood and sheet metal, stood at the rear of the lot, behind a house at the front that was not destroyed. The flames spread quickly and could be seen from several blocks away. Neighbors called 911 and tried to help by throwing buckets of water on the fire before firefighters arrived.

Neighbors and relatives helped the residents get out in time, and no one was hurt, according to the report. Civil Protection personnel also helped move belongings out of the homes. The elderly man has health problems, the report said.

Firefighters from Nuevo Laredo's Heroic Fire Department brought the fire under control and then carried out cooling and removal work. Both homes were a total loss, along with the belongings, clothing, furniture, and appliances inside. The house at the front of the lot was also affected by the fire, though its residents were not hurt.

The cause of the fire is unknown, and an investigation was to be carried out, according to El Mañana. No donation appeal or collection point was published.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

title: Fire Destroys Two Homes in Nuevo Laredo's Colonia Matamoros
